note: Point edits of the elephant body (README, "Point edits"). pnpm glb-point-edits assets/models/elephant/elephant-edits.json writes elephant.rig.glb from the file of the base commit, and pnpm studio-body elephant then writes src/models/studio/elephant.ts. The keys are vertex indices of the primitive fur, and the moves are in the stored space of the file (the bind).

groups.name: eye_R
groups.note: One fur vertex of the head at the inner side of the right eye socket, 0.12 H from the middle of the old eye, moves 0.02 H toward that middle in the plane of the eye (H: the head height of the bead eyes, 0.1853 units). Its face and the two filled vertices of the socket (eyeFill) lay on one line in the plane of the eye, so the face stood on its edge and showed as a thin dark crease.

groups.name: eye_L
groups.note: One fur vertex of the head at the inner side of the left eye socket, 0.066 H from the middle of the old eye, moves 0.015 H toward that middle in the plane of the eye. Its face lay on one line in the plane of the eye, as on the right side.
